title: USB serial enumeration can exceed caller capacity on multi-interface devices
summary: indigo_usbserial_utils.c:100-111: macOS outer USB loop checks count < num_serial_info, but inner descendant loop writes serial_info[count] and increments for every serial endpoint without checking capacity. A multi-interface device when one slot remains overwrites caller storage. Framework indigo_driver.c:280 supplies a fixed MAX_DEVICE_PORTS array. Next: Enforce capacity before each inner output write; stop/release iterator objects without leaks. Verify multi-endpoint device metadata with capacity one and a canary.
